Commentary.Commentary: 211 is needed by Bangladesh to avoid a series sweep. Possible? The answer will be clearer on the other side.

Inconsistent bowling by Bangladesh. They started badly, then recovered well, lost it again, pulled it back once more, only to allow the river flow in the death. Nazmul Islam was the pick of the bowlers with 0/28 in 4 overs while everyone else struggled.

The hosts were eyeing a target in excess of 200 when Perera was going bonkers but they managed to break through. Not once, but twice. They got both the set batsmen and in two new players in Tharanga and Shanaka at the crease, seemed like the momentum was slipping away. But the duo added 45 in just 19 balls for the fourth wicket, pummeling Bangladesh to all parts and racing past 200.

Good batting all the way through by the visiting side. Gunathilaka and Mendis set it up with a 98-run stand and the wicket came about because of the pressure applied by Bangladesh post the Powerplay, which had yielded 63 runs. But the 51-run stand for the second wicket between Mendis and Thisara pushed Bangladesh back again.

Excellent score posted by Sri Lanka. Dinesh Chandimal said at the toss that 170 is a good total and his side has given him a buffer of 30 runs. There is dew already present but this will take some chasing.
A good ball to finish, nearly a yorker, pushed wide of long off for a couple. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 210/4!
A short ball now, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE again. But of a different type. This is given because it is bowled well outside the guidelines outside off.
WIDE. Don't need extras at this stage. Saifuddin bowls a bouncer and it is well over Shanaka's head.
Dinesh Chandimal walks out to complete the formalities.
OUT! Tharanga departs. A full ball outside off, Tharanga looks to go big but finds Soumya Sarkar at long off. Not a bad knock at all - 25 from 13 balls.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Part two is even better. A low full toss outside off, Shanaka sends this out of Sylhet taking the long off route. 200 reached in a canter.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, slashed over point for a boundary! Nice beginning.
Gets the over done with by a full ball, hit down to long off for a single. What an over - 17 from it. The previous Fizz over had 2 dots and a wicket. This one has 1 dot and 4 boundaries.

Dhaka looking, Chittagong turning. Who wants to be a bowler? Not me. Mustafizur slyly bowls a length ball outside off, angling away, slows the pace and deceives Shanaka by getting a top edge. But where does it go? Over short third man and to the fence.

FOUR! Tough luck for the bowler. He bowls a very full ball following the batsman down the leg side, Shanaka swings his bat hard and gets it off the inner half. Not exactly Steven Smithesque who got it between his legs against Morne Morkel in an ODI in Australia, but this is good enough to beat short fine leg.

FOUR! A length ball on middle, Shanaka swings hard and gets it wide of mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep who runs in to his right and dives but cannot get to the ball. Misses it too and concedes a boundary.
Now a slower one, outside off, Dasun swings early and misses.
FOUR! Mid off is up and Shanaka's eyes light up. A full toss, Shanaka just lofts it over mid off and gets a boundary.
A rare dot ball as Upul swings but misses a length ball outside off. 16 from that over. 200 still on?
FOUR! UT is teeing off on this buffet by Jayed. Another bad ball. A short ball, angling away, Tharanga just pulls it uppishly, wide of the man at deep mid-wicket and finds the fence again.
FOUR! Thank you. Length on the previous one, no length on this one. It is a low full toss, around knee height, Tharanga swats it over mid-wicket and finds the fence.
SIX! PLUNDERED! A length ball, on middle and leg, Tharanga just swings it mightily over long on!
Outside off, played through point for a run.
A length ball on middle, Tharanga looks to pull but gets a top edge. So bad is the shot that the ball does not even carry to mid on. Just a single.

RUN OUT MISSED! Excellent ball to start first up. A yorker, outside off, Tharanga dabs it to the off side and sets off. Mustafizur quickly gets to the ball, picks it up, turns around and then has a shy at the striker's end. Would have had Dasun Shanaka but the throw misses the stumps. What an over - 3 runs and a wicket. Momentum shifts again.
A short ball outside off, slower in pace, UT lets it go. The umpire signals one bouncer for the over but not a wide.

An LBW appeal but the umpire has spotted the presence of wood. A full ball, around off, Upul looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen meanwhile look for the single but Tharanga is sent back in time.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in.

OUT! Mendis departs now! Two big wicket for Bangladesh in the space of 7 balls. Both set batsmen gone. A short ball outside off, Mendis looks to pull but the ball gets big on him. He skies it high in the air and only finds Mahedi Hasan at wide long on. Departs for 70 from 42 balls, a fine knock but should he have stayed till the end?
Full on middle and leg, flicked behind square leg for a run.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
FOUR! Unlucky is Jayed again! Full and wide outside off, Tharanga throws his bat at it but the ball goes off the outside edge. Where? Past short third man for a boundary.
A slower ball now, shorter in length, Upul looks to pull but is beaten.
WIDE. Harsh call. Full and around off, slanting away, left alone. The umpire stretches his arms but the bowler is not happy. Replays show why. The ball was well inside the guidelines.

FOUR! GORGEOUS! We rarely get to use such adjectives but such was the shot from the new man. It was the first ball he faced and it was a half volley. Tharanga got his feet to the pitch of the ball and just played a lovely-looking cover drive. Got a boundary!
Upul Tharanga walks in at number 4, replacing Thisara.

OUT! Caught! Massive, massive wicket. That could change the momentum again. A full ball outside off, Perera, who was looking to hit every ball out of the park, went after this one too. But the ball hit the toe end of his bat and scooped to long off. Simple catch to Soumya Sarkar. Bangladesh can now dream of restricting the Lankans under 200. Terrific cameo from Thisara - 31 from 17 balls, 3 fours and 1 maximum.
It's been lofted over mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Abu Jayed to start the carnage of the death overs.
Another dot. A yorker outside off, squeezed straight to point. 10 from that over as well. 49 from the last 4.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.
A dot ball. Wow. Full and outside off, angling away, Thisara lets it go. Perhaps expecting a wide.
Almost concedes a boundary. Full and outside off, Perera blasts this wide of long off. Ariful Haque gets across, slides, then fumbles but manages to save the boundary. Two runs taken.
Full and outside off, driven towards wide long off for a single.
SIX! The boundaries are flowing now. A length ball around off, Mendis gets across and scoops it over short fine leg! It goes all the way!
Mohammad Saifuddin is back on.

FOUR! Make that 18! The momentum is back with the Lankans. 39 have come from the last 3 overs. Full and outside off, Thisara clubs this just two feet wide of long off but the brute power beats that fielder!
A length ball outside off, Perera punches this wide of long off and charges back for the second. Already 14 from the over.
SIX! There you go. Perera will not miss twice in a row. A full ball outside off, TP swings it high and handsome over the sightscreen.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.

ALMOST PAYS OFF! What a fielding change from Mahmudullah. Another full toss outside off, Thisara repeats his previous shot and nearly finds the man stationed just there. It dips in front of Mahmudullah at that straightish long off position and the batsmen take a single.
Tamim Iqbal is having a word with Sarkar. Third man comes into the circle now. Mahmudullah goes to a very, very straightish long off.
FOUR! MURDERED! A low full toss, outside off, Perera likes it. Clears his front leg and hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary down the ground.

There is a little break. Mushfiqur Rahim is having some issue with his eyes. Looks like something has gone in. The physio is checking it out. Well, the players are going back to their positions but cannot say that Rahim is entirely happy. Still struggling and shaking his head.
Change of ends for the partnership-breaker.
Full and outside off, bunted down to long off for a single. 11 from the over, 21 from the last 2. The run-rate is picking up again...

FOUR! Lucky escape. A short ball, Perera swings and gets a top edge. Does not matter even if it is caught because it is a Free Hit but to Bangladesh's dismay, even that does not go to hand. Lobs over short fine leg and then scoots to the fence.
FREE HIT TIME!!!

NO BALL! That is a high full toss, around middle and leg, Perera pushes it wide of long on. Excellent thinking from the batsmen as they charge back for the second. Now, Bangladesh cannot change their field.
Comes down the track but the bowler cramps him for room by bowling a high full toss. Mendis can only push it down to long on for one.
A full toss now, whipped through mid-wicket for only a run.
Full and outside off, Perera goes hard and mistimes it towards extra cover.
A length ball outside off, slapped over cover for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman into the attack now.
A short ball again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one more. 10 runs from that over, a much-needed one for the batting side.
Punches this down to long off for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
A long hop, dragged through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! IMPERIOUS! Full and outside off, Mendis heaves this over mid on and finds the fence.
On middle and leg, chipped over square leg for a single.
Mohammad Saifuddin into the attack as well.
Interesting. Thisara Perera has been sent in at number 3.

OUT! Caught! No 100-run stand. The pressure was building and something was going to give. Sarkar bowls this slightly wider than the previous one and Gunathilaka looks to go over the top. Hits it well but finds Tamim Iqbal at the wide long off boundary. A timely wicket for the hosts.
Misses a full toss. Danushka looks to play the reverse paddle but misses.
WIDE. This is a slower bouncer, but it bounces well over the batsman's head.
Around off, dug out back to the bowler.

FOUR! Lucky! A short ball, on off, Gunathilaka attempts the reverse paddle, is nowhere near the ball and ends up gloving it. But such is his luck that the ball flies over the keeper to the third man fence!

HALF CENTURY FOR MENDIS! Back-to-back ones. Outside off, on a length, he dabs this straight to short third man. There should have been a run out as Gunathilaka was charging wildly. But instead, they get an overthrow and Mendis stays on to fight more.
On middle and leg, Gunathilaka gets down and laps it down to fine leg for a single.
Another bowling change. Soumya Sarkar to bowl some medium pace.
Very good bowling again. Just short of a yorker, very, very full, driven through the covers for only one. Bangladesh slowly tightening things up.
A fine yorker, dug out back to the bowler.
On middle and off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
LBW appeal, but in vain. The straighter one, on middle and leg, Danushka attempts a reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Perhaps going down leg.
Full and outside off, hit wide of long off for a couple.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Full and wide outside off, outside the guidelines, Danushka gets across and slashes but misses. Now wide signalled because the batsman moved that far.
A yorker, outside off, Gunathilaka looks to squeeze it out but misses.
Fuller on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.

FOUR! HAMMERED! This is what happens when you telegraph stuff. Kusal Mendis seems to know when Abu Jayed is going to bowl that slower one. Gets across well in advance, is down on a knee, still, Jayed bowls a slower ball and short on middle. Scooped over short fine leg.

A huge LBW shout but nothing in it. Pitched outside leg, slow in pace, Gunathilaka is early into his swing and misses the ball. It deflects off his pads through fine leg and a single is taken. Leg bye signalled.
Abu Jayed is back on.

Very good running. Full and on middle, Kusal plays this with soft hands wide of long on and runs hard to come back for the second. One of those rare overs where no boundary was scored, yet, 6 runs came from it.
Now a full toss, outside off, smashed down to long off for another single.
This is fired on middle and leg, flicked wide of mid-wicket for one.
Comes down the track but is yorked. Mendis can only push it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Short and outside off, punched down to long on for a single.
Nazmul Islam into the attack now.

DROPPED! Hmmm... should have been taken. Danushka smashes this over covers where Mahmudullah, waits and then times his jump to perfection. Gets his hands to the ball but cannot hang on. Two runs taken. 10 from that over, 26 off the last 2!
Full and straight, pushed through to long on for a run.

Excellent shot, terrific fielding! Wonderful cricket all around. Mendis gets down and across and laps this length ball beautifully behind square on the leg side. It seems to be heading towards the ropes but Mahedi Hasan gives it a good chase from deep mid-wicket, gets to the ball, leaps and then pushes it back in! Short fine leg then gets to the ball and returns the throw. Two runs taken.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot. This time there is connection. Once again Gunathilaka charges out, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it over mid off for a boundary.

Comes down the track, does Gunathilaka, gets a short delivery, swings wildly but misses. An alert Rahim has a shy at the stumps, trying to stump him but misses. If only Rahim had been alert on the previous occasion when Gunathilaka was out of the crease against Jayed...
Mohammad Saifuddin into the attack now.
SIX! That is out of here! Ends the Powerplay with a bang! Once again uses his feet and lofts it over mid-wicket for a maximum. 63 for 0 after the first 6.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Another appeal, a stifled one. Gives it air on off, Gunathilaka goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Height was an issue there.

A huge shout but not given! Slower through the air on off, turning back in. Mendis once again goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. It goes down towards short fine leg for a leg bye. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg maybe!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is excellent from Mendis. He goes down early and the bowler bowls it on the stumps. Mendis sweeps it over the square leg fence for a one bounce boundary.
FOUR! 50 up for Lanka and in style! Hasan tosses it up outside off, Mendis goes inside out over covers and the ball races away.
Mehedi Hasan is back on.
A dot to finish! A short ball with a lot of fizz. Gunathilaka evades it.
Fuller outside off, Mendis tries to drive but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.

NOT OUT! Mendis is easily in! Full and on middle, pushed towards mid on and the batsmen set off for a run. The fielder there hits bull's eye and the players appeal. It is not a confident one though. The umpire still takes it upstairs and replays show Mendis is in.
A direct hit at the non-striker's end and the players make an appeal. Mendis seems to be in but just to be sure the umpire takes it upstairs.
Another short ball, this time though Danushka does not time it as he hits it off the inner half through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Gunathilaka is not holding back here, he is dealing in boundaries. Short and on middle, Gunathilaka camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket for another boundary.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.

DROPPED! A tough chance but should have taken it. Gunathilaka makes room and gets a full ball on the stumps. He hits it hard towards Tamim at mid off who dives full stretch to his right, gets two hands to it but can't hang on. A let off for the batsman, how costly will this prove? A single to end the over, 14 from it.
SIX! Sri Lanka are off to a flier! Floats it up on off, right in the arc. Danuska goes down on one knee and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence.
Works it against the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Excellent use of the feet! Mendis charges down and gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the bowler for a maximum.
A low full toss on the pads, Mendis fails to put it away and flicks it straight to square leg.
Tosses it up on off, Mendis pushes it to covers.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
SIX! Short and dispatched! Short and once again into the body of the batsman. Gunathilaka has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it over mid-wicket for a biggie. First of the match.
Gunathilaka makes room and the bowler follows him with a flatter delivery. The batsman keeps it out.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Walks across and sweeps it over the square leg fielder. He though has not timed it well but has played it well enough to take two.
Tosses it up on off, Gunathilaka drives it down to long off for a run.
Mehedi Hasan comes into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven down to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! Gunathilaka was in quiet easily. Islam fires it down the leg  side. Gunathilaka misses his flick and also loses his balance. Mushfiqur though, fails to collect the ball as it hits his glove and deflects onto the stumps. He appeals and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Gunathilaka has his foot back in. Had Rahim collected it cleanly things would have been interesting. The umpire has also given it as a wide.

An early referral! They have gone upstairs to check for a stumping. Gunathilaka is the man in question, he did lose his balance after playing the shot but the Bangladesh players don't seem to be confident.
Full outside off, Gunathilaka makes room and slaps it hard but straight to covers.
Once again uses his feet but drives it back to the bowler.
Charges down the track and yorks himself. Gunathilaka jams it back to the bowler.
Works it against the spin towards wide mid on for a run.
Nazmul Islam will bowl from the other end.

In the air... but well short! A bouncer on middle, Mendis goes for the pull, he does not quite time it well and hits it uppishly but well short of the fielder at deep square leg for a run. 12 runs from the first over, a good start for Lanka.
WIDE! Full and swinging away outside off, Mendis makes a leave and the umpire stretches.
Full and coming back into the batsman. Mendis tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.

FOUR! The Bangladesh bowlers aren't learning, are they? They were giving Mendis room in the last game and were punished. They continue doing the same. Full and wide, Kusal loves it there. He slashes hard and the ball goes over cover-point for a boundary.
On a length around off, Kusal keeps it out.
Wide! Down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.

FOUR! Mendis has started from where he left off in the last game. He needs no sighters. Fuller in length on off, Kusal drives it on the up over mid off and the ball races away for the first boundary of the day.
Runs straightaway! Full and on off, no swing on offer. Gunathilaka drives it to mid off for a quick run.

Okay! We are all set for the battle to begin. Danushka Gunathilaka and Kusal Mendis are the openers for Sri Lanka. One of the debutants for today, Abu Jayed, will start off the proceedings, against Gunathilaka. Here we go!

Sri Lankan captain, Dinesh Chandimal, says that he too, would have liked to bowl first bgut now wants his side to put up a good total. Around 170 is his idea of a good score. Wants his team to enjoy its cricket and play well. Informs about the sole change - Niroshan Dickwella missing out and Amila Aponso coming in.

Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudllah, says that the decision is because of the dew coming in later. Wants to utilize the conditions as he has two spinners in his side. Hopes that his team puts on a good show today. Informs that there are four changes to his side.
TOSS time. A very special gold coin has been commemorated for Bangladesh's first international match in Sylhet. Mahmudullah flips the coin and TAILS is the call. It is HEADS. BANGLADESH WILL CHASE.
PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo doing the analysis says that the track looks a belter. There is a little bit of grass around but that should not make any difference. Dew is expected later in the evening.

The final match of this tour. Started like another drubbing in the offing for the Lankans, only to see them swarm through the entire path. Now, cometh the second T20I, Sri Lanka once again look favourites to win and grab their third series win of this tour. Bangladesh, on the other hand, lost the final of the tri-series, lost the Test series and have one final chance to salvage one series at least. Injuries and loss of form have crippled them, though that does not take away the fact that they have performed badly. This is Bangladesh's first international game at this venue, so that should be a good motivation. Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka in Sylhet.
